name: registry-contracts
fault_schedule: test/scenarios/registry/s3.json; deterministic signed HTTP response loss/cancellation immediately after successful real PUT, including a subsequent conditional writer before readback. Unit HTTP 409/412/500/503 controls.
assertions: Shared real-backend create/replace races admit exactly one winner.
Replays preserve identity/digest; immediate changed-digest reuse is invalid; stale versions and same-payload ABA cannot publish.
Exactly one SDK mutation attempt even when client configured for four retries.
Committed loss reconciles exact bytes; later record, before-commit loss and cancellation after dispatch remain unknown.
Bounded strict reads reject oversized/corrupt objects; reopening independent client reads published state.
The same shared contract suite passes for the local filesystem adapter.
Filesystem process death after rename recovers file and directory durability; cross-process CAS and restart preserve exact versions.
limitations: Local pinned MinIO only; no real AWS qualification.
Namespace must exclude deletes, lifecycle expiry and out-of-band writers.
No production format migration or caller wiring.
S3 durability assumes successful service response; no emulator-server crash durability test.
Callers must retain UnknownOutcome across separate invocations and use registry.Reconcile; no historical receipt journal.
Filesystem results apply only to the executed local platform; NFS/SMB remain unqualified. Source omission controls and pinned Linux qualification run through their separately documented runners.
